svg.title: A support ticket is routed by severity and reopened until it is fixed
svg.desc: Flowchart. Start. Ticket arrives. How severe? critical: page on-call engineer (step 4). normal: add to team queue (step 5). low: send help article (step 6). Page on-call engineer. Add to team queue. Send help article. Work the ticket. End. Fixed? yes: end (step 8). no: work the ticket (step 7).
